ex.en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.
ex.zh: 這些資料可不可靠還很難說。

ex.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我更新這份資料嗎？

ex.en: However, all these data were not confirmed.
ex.zh: 不過，這些資料都還沒有得到證實。

ex.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
ex.zh: 我們優化了資料庫索引，系統效率因此提高了 50%。

ex.en: Just because it's in Tatoeba.org's database, doesn't mean it's a sentence.
ex.zh: 出現在 Tatoeba 資料庫裡的，不一定就是句子。

ex.en: It was daytime.
ex.zh: 那時是白天。

ex.en: The office is quiet during the daytime.
ex.zh: 白天辦公室很安靜。

ex.en: Daytime temperatures will reach 30 degrees.
ex.zh: 白天氣溫會達到三十度。

ex.en: I have to dash, or I'll miss my train.
ex.zh: 我得趕快走了，不然會趕不上火車。

ex.en: She dashed out of the office to catch the bus.
ex.zh: 她衝出辦公室去趕公車。

ex.en: The injury dashed his hopes of playing in the final.
ex.zh: 這次受傷讓他打決賽的希望破滅了。

ex.en: Bad weather dashed our plans for a beach trip.
ex.zh: 壞天氣讓我們去海邊的計畫泡湯了。

ex.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
ex.zh: 他創下了百米短跑的世界新紀錄。

ex.en: We made a dash for the exit when the rain started.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時，我們衝向出口。

ex.en: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一點鹽。

ex.en: I'd like my tea with a dash of milk.
ex.zh: 我的茶要加一點點牛奶。

ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們每天至少應該睡八小時。

ex.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天低於零度。

ex.en: Bats sleep during the day.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠白天睡覺。

ex.en: I work during the day and study at night.
ex.zh: 我白天工作，晚上讀書。

ex.en: You work too hard these days. Aren't you tired?
ex.zh: 你最近工作太拚了，不累嗎？

ex.en: These days, many people work from home.
ex.zh: 現在很多人在家工作。

ex.en: The flood caused a lot of damage.
ex.zh: 洪水造成了很大的損害。

ex.en: The damage will cost us a lot of money.
ex.zh: 這些損壞會讓我們花很多錢。

ex.en: The fire caused serious damage to the factory.
ex.zh: 這場火災對工廠造成了嚴重的損害。

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨吹壞了我們社區的許多樹。

ex.en: Tom tried to crack a walnut without damaging its kernel.
ex.zh: 湯姆試著敲開核桃，又不弄壞裡面的果仁。

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現一隻翅膀嚴重受傷的鳥。

ex.en: They sued the government for damages.
ex.zh: 他們控告政府，要求損害賠償。

ex.en: The court ordered the company to pay damages.
ex.zh: 法院判決公司支付損害賠償。

ex.en: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
ex.zh: 一走進漆黑的隧道，我們就什麼都看不見了。

ex.en: The sky grew darker and darker.
ex.zh: 天色越來越暗了。

ex.en: This color is a bit darker than that one.
ex.zh: 這個顏色比那個深一點。

ex.en: He was wearing a dark suit.
ex.zh: 他穿著深色西裝。

ex.en: Cats can see in the dark.
ex.zh: 貓在黑暗中看得見。

ex.en: Many children are afraid of the dark.
ex.zh: 很多小孩都怕黑。

ex.en: I'm going to buy a camera for my daughter.
ex.zh: 我打算買一台相機給我女兒。

ex.en: We have got two daughters and two sons.
ex.zh: 我們有兩個女兒和兩個兒子。

ex.en: He has two daughters who have both married doctors.
ex.zh: 他有兩個女兒，都嫁給了醫生。

ex.en: Most people write about their daily life.
ex.zh: 大部分人寫的都是自己的日常生活。

ex.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
ex.zh: 他的日常行為和他的原則不一致。

ex.en: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
ex.zh: 運動是我每天例行的事。

ex.en: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
ex.zh: 外幣匯率每天都在變動。

ex.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在波動。

ex.en: Putting in effort daily is essential to language learning.
ex.zh: 每天下功夫是學好語言的關鍵。

ex.en: My best friend dances really well.
ex.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。

ex.en: Emi danced the most beautifully of the three girls.
ex.zh: 三個女孩中，惠美跳得最好看。

ex.en: Would you like to dance?
ex.zh: 你想跳支舞嗎？

ex.en: The dance had already started when I got there.
ex.zh: 我到的時候舞會已經開始了。

ex.en: She learned a traditional dance from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她跟奶奶學了一支傳統舞蹈。

ex.en: Are you saying that my life is in danger?
ex.zh: 你是說我有生命危險嗎？

ex.en: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋有倒塌的危險。

ex.en: That is how he got out of danger.
ex.zh: 他就是這樣脫離危險的。

ex.en: It's dangerous to climb a mountain in bad weather.
ex.zh: 天氣不好時爬山很危險。

ex.en: We thought it dangerous for her to go alone.
ex.zh: 我們覺得她一個人去很危險。

ex.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
ex.zh: 這條河對孩子來說游泳太危險了。

ex.en: My dad is not at home for the moment.
ex.zh: 我爸爸現在不在家。

ex.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
ex.zh: 我爸被我那個蠢問題嚇了一大跳。

ex.en: Dad! Mom! I have some great news for you!
ex.zh: 爸！媽！我有好消息要告訴你們！

ex.en: She didn't dare to say anything at that time.
ex.zh: 那時她什麼都不敢說。

ex.en: I've always wanted to meet her, but I've never dared.
ex.zh: 我一直想認識她，但從來不敢。

ex.en: I don't dare to do that kind of thing.
ex.zh: 我不敢做這種事。

ex.en: How dare you speak to me like that?
ex.zh: 你怎麼敢這麼跟我說話？

ex.en: How dare you read my messages!
ex.zh: 你怎麼敢看我的訊息！

ex.en: I dare say there'll be taxis at the station.
ex.zh: 我想車站應該會有計程車。

ex.en: I dare say you're right.
ex.zh: 我想你說得對。

damn.zh: 該死、可惡（表示惱怒，口語）

ex.en: Damn, I left my umbrella on the train.
ex.zh: 可惡，我把雨傘忘在火車上了。

ex.en: Damn! I missed the last bus.
ex.zh: 該死！我錯過末班公車了。

damn.zh: not give a damn：毫不在乎

ex.en: I don't give a damn what people think about me.
ex.zh: 我才不在乎別人怎麼看我。

ex.en: I don't give a damn what you think of me.
ex.zh: 我不在乎你怎麼看我。

ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
ex.zh: 我們的眼睛需要時間適應黑暗。

ex.en: His black coat blended into the darkness.
ex.zh: 他的黑外套融入了黑暗中。

ex.en: The darkness will work to my advantage.
ex.zh: 黑暗對我有利。

ex.en: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
ex.zh: 天氣不只冷，還很潮濕。

ex.en: Clean the window with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 用濕抹布擦窗戶。

ex.en: This damp match won't light.
ex.zh: 這根火柴受潮了，點不著。

ex.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.
ex.zh: 為了這次重要的約會，她精心打扮了一番。

ex.en: They went on their first date last Friday.
ex.zh: 他們上週五第一次約會。

ex.en: Who told you that Tom and I are dating?
ex.zh: 誰告訴你我和湯姆在交往的？

ex.en: Dan dated Linda when she was a teenager.
ex.zh: 丹在琳達十幾歲時跟她交往過。

ex.en: Would you ever consider dating your best friend's ex-boyfriend?
ex.zh: 你會考慮跟好朋友的前男友交往嗎？

ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
ex.zh: 製造日期印在蓋子上。

ex.en: No one can have three different birth dates.
ex.zh: 沒有人會有三個不同的生日。

ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.
ex.zh: 我的車在車禍中嚴重損壞。

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨吹壞了我們社區很多樹。

ex.en: Daddy, I love you!
ex.zh: 爸爸，我愛你！

ex.en: Where did Daddy go?
ex.zh: 爸爸去哪裡了？

ex.en: Daddy loves to say funny things.
ex.zh: 爹地喜歡講有趣的事。

dame.zh: 夫人、女爵士（英國授予女性的爵位）

ex.en: The famous actress was made a Dame for her services to theater.
ex.zh: 這位知名女演員因對戲劇界的貢獻而獲封女爵士。

ex.en: Dame Judi Dench is loved by audiences around the world.
ex.zh: 茱蒂．丹契女爵士深受全球觀眾喜愛。

ex.en: I daresay you're tired after such a long trip.
ex.zh: 我想你經過這麼長的旅途一定累了。

ex.en: I daresay they'll be late again tonight.
ex.zh: 我看他們今晚大概又會遲到。

ex.en: The warning light appeared on the dashboard during the drive.
ex.zh: 行駛途中，儀表板上的警示燈亮了。

ex.en: Managers can track monthly sales on the dashboard.
ex.zh: 主管可以在控制面板上追蹤每月銷售額。
